title: Daily Workout · November 4
note: Incline walking and the glute/core exercises missed yesterday. No jogging today. Work at moderate effort and reduce incline if legs are sore.

items.name: Lying quad stretch
items.instructions: Lie on your side and gently bring your heel toward your glutes.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Sit upright with soles together; relax knees.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Rotate gently, avoiding forceful low-back twisting.

items.name: Plow Pose (Halasana)
items.detail: 1 minute including gentle entry and exit
items.instructions: Use only comfortable range; avoid neck pressure. Skip if neck or back discomfort.

items.name: Hill walk 5 percent
items.instructions: Walk tall and avoid gripping the rails.

items.name: Hill walk 6–7 percent
items.instructions: Reduce incline if legs are sore or breathing becomes difficult.

items.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlifts
items.instructions: Start around 15–20 lb per hand if comfortable; maintain neutral back and hinge at hips.

items.name: Weighted glute bridges
items.instructions: Hold the top contraction for 2 seconds without arching the back.

items.name: Resistance-band lateral steps
items.instructions: Keep tension on the band and knees slightly bent.

items.name: Bodyweight squats
items.instructions: Descend with control and stand tall, squeezing glutes.

items.name: Side planks
items.detail: 3 min · 2 × 35 sec each side, with rest
items.instructions: Keep hips lifted and torso aligned.

items.name: Suitcase carries
items.detail: 3 min · 2 × 35 sec each side, with rest
items.instructions: Carry one dumbbell and avoid leaning.

items.name: Bent-knee leg raises
items.instructions: Lower slowly without arching lower back.

items.name: Dead bugs
items.instructions: Move opposite arm and leg slowly while maintaining core control.
